context: Saito gives Naoko a careful checkup.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 直子さん、本当、健康、保てる、ね。
lines.en: Naoko-san, your health really has been well maintained.
lines.style: Warm, steady opening. Professional composure with genuine care underneath. Delivers the reassurance as a quiet fact, not flattery. Slight pause before the affirmation, as if choosing words with real weight.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.style: Soft, earnest gratitude. Voice catches slightly on the second 'truly'—not breaking, but showing the feeling beneath. Warm and direct, without performance.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: What you do for your health—that takes real commitment.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. Acknowledges the patient's effort with genuine respect. Slight lean into the word 'commitment,' as if naming something she's noticed over time.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Please, if you ever need advice, anytime at all.
lines.style: Warm and accessible. The word 'anytime' is open—she means it, not as a formality but as an invitation. Soft, genuine offer without pressure.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 一緒に、本当、頑張りましょう。
lines.en: Let's keep working at this together.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Slight lift on 'together'—partnering, not prescribing. Steady, calm, the voice of someone who will be there for the long term.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: It makes me happy to see you doing so well.
lines.style: Sincere and warm. Softly emotional—she's speaking not just as doctor but as someone who cares. Genuine pleasure in the words, without becoming unprofessional.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.style: Closing warmth. A benediction rather than an instruction. The 'truly' is tender, almost whispered, carrying all the care of the appointment into a send-off.
